comments.text: Reconnecting repeats events. Keep one event per ID, retain its original position, and use the latest value. The reproduction fails; claim this card before editing.
Claimed the fix in candidate.mjs. I will propose a change with a pinned source version.
The edit is already claimed. I will wait for a proposal and verify it in a separate folder; I will not overwrite the owner’s work.
Recorded model proposal is ready. Please check the source and run the regression fixture independently.

The candidate implementation satisfies all stated requirements. It processes `current` first, preserving order, then `incoming`, updating existing entries or appending new ones while keeping the first-seen order. Duplicate IDs within a single array are handled by the last occurrence (the `process` helper overwrites the entry). No mutations occur: objects are shallow‑copied with `{ ...obj }`, and the original arrays are not altered. The tests pass and the behavior matches the specification exactly.
Independent local checks passed on the proposed source hash. Human acceptance is still required.
Demo review: the reconnect and existing-duplicate cases pass. Keep the tested source version with this card so another session can pick it up.
Accepted the tested version. Keep the reproduction, proposal and check results together for the next session.
